items.title: 用 Google Antigravity 实现智能体化学信息学 / Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity

sources.title: 用 Google Antigravity 实现智能体化学信息学 / Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity
sources.title_zh: 用 Google Antigravity 实现智能体化学信息学
sources.title_en: Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity
sources.title_original: Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章展示 Google Antigravity 搭配 Cheminformatics Skills，在真实肺癌治疗案例中让 agent 搜索数千化合物、做 matched molecular pair analysis，并在一小时内提出 novel rigidified macrocycles 及合成路线，而传统单次迭代常需多天。

en.reason: In a real lung cancer case, Google Antigravity with Cheminformatics Skills let an agent search thousands of compounds, run matched molecular pair analysis, and propose novel rigidified macrocycles and synthesis routes within an hour, versus days for typical iteration.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Marcus Ash披露Win11 26H2原生测速工具由Diego Bacca利用业余时间一天做出原型、AI agent承担执行迭代，而此前与Ookla合作版只是Bing网页包装。
